headline: Stonecradle Flares While Mercy and Expanse Battle On
war_summary: Since the last edition the wire has shifted sharply, with Stonecradle turning the busiest post at seven changes in two hours and thirteen in the day about The Dais and The Reach, holding seven Colonial and two neutral amid accelerating losses. Weathered Expanse stays fast with five changes in two hours and thirty-seven in the day at Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Necropolis, now six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral with the latest change at the hour. Linn Mercy eases to six in two hours and thirty-six in the day at Lathair and Outwich Ranch, now one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral. Palantine Berm and Nevish Line have gone quiet in the last two hours after heavy twenty-four-hour tallies of forty-seven and eight. Marban Hollow cools to one change in two hours and twenty-nine in the day at Checkpoint Bua, now four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. Gutter and Farranac Coast show fresh movement while Mooring County stays silent since the early morning, and heavy casualties without flips continue in Clahstra, Callum's Cape and Callahan's Passage.
